verdict.rationale: Moneybird is accounting software, so customizing the chart of accounts is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack covers only authentication, contacts, MCP/CLI/webhooks, invoicing, sandboxes and API versioning. Nothing documents ledger accounts, account types, sub-accounts, or class/tag dimensions.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions
